question: Why could Los Angeles dictate its own terms for hosting the 1984 Summer Olympics?
answer: Because it was the only city bidding. After Montreal's debts, Tehran had pulled out, and the IOC had to accept a privately run Games with no city money at risk. Organisers reused the 1932 Coliseum, sold sponsorships and made a surplus of over $200 million, part of which still funds youth sport in Los Angeles.
move: The side with no competitors writes the contract.
reference: Los Angeles Olympic Organizing Committee, Official Report of the Games of the XXIIIrd Olympiad Los Angeles 1984, 1985
